issues.title: Illegible dialog header contrast
issues.description: The dialog title lacks adequate contrast against the light container background.
issues.evidence: The heading 'حذف المرفق؟' renders in light gray/white text on a white modal surface.
issues.suggestion: Apply a high-contrast text color token to the dialog title.
issues.triageNote: Confirmed: Dialog.Content hardcoded bg-[#ffffff]/border-[#e5e5e5] while the composed Title uses text-default-font (near-white in dark) — replaced with bg-panel/border-default-border tokens in Dialog.tsx; verified live (panel rgb(21,21,19), title rgb(241,239,233)) and by vision re-audit of pair-116 (no ds:Dialog issues remain).

issues.title: Confined dialog scrim clipping content
issues.description: The dialog overlay renders within a bounded sidebar container rather than portaling globally, cutting off underlying helper text.
issues.evidence: Dark overlay rectangle in the right column partially masks text, leaving orphan word 'completes.' exposed at bottom edge.
issues.suggestion: Mount dialog via a portal to cover the entire viewport.
issues.triageNote: The inline (non-portaled) scrim inside a bounded frame is the component's documented demo idiom, used deliberately by the eval page; measured DOM geometry shows the scrim fully covers its frame (394–704 vs frame 393–705 incl. borders), so the 'orphan word' evidence does not reproduce. Improvements applied: scrim no longer paints while closed (empty:hidden — Radix keeps the root mounted so the 60% black scrim previously dimmed the frame forever after dismissal) and the inline-scrim idiom + full-viewport guidance is documented in meta.ts.

issues.title: Low contrast dialog title
issues.description: The dialog title uses light text on a light background, rendering it illegible.
issues.evidence: The 'Delete account?' heading in the Danger Zone dialog blends into the white container background.
issues.suggestion: Update the dialog title color token to ensure sufficient contrast against the surface.
issues.triageNote: Same root cause as pair-116: hardcoded white panel vs token-driven title in dark theme — fixed via bg-panel/border-default-border tokens; verified live on /eval/pair-166 (dark, 390x844: panel rgb(21,21,19), title rgb(241,239,233)).
